caption: Plenty of past customers haven't gone anywhere, they just never got a nudge when it was time to come back. If a friendly message went out for you, in your voice, how many would book in again? Comment AGENT below.

slides.headline: Your old customers haven't left. They've drifted.
They liked your work.
slides.body: Then life got busy and nobody reminded them it was time to book again.

slides.headline: You never reached out.
slides.body: You're flat out with new jobs. Messaging past customers always slips.

slides.headline: So they go quiet for months.
slides.body: Easy repeat work, sitting in your contacts, doing nothing.

slides.headline: What if a nudge went out for you?
slides.body: A friendly message when it's time to book again. In your voice. Without you remembering.

slides.headline: You only handle the replies.
slides.body: If they want a time, you pick it up. If they're unsure, it hands the chat back to you.

beats.text: Your old customers haven't left. They've drifted.
They liked your work. Nobody reminded them to book again.
You're busy with new jobs. Messaging old ones never happens.
What if a friendly nudge went out for you?
When it's time to book again. In your voice.
beats.bubble: Hi! It's been a while. Want me to find you a time to book in again?
